NGA.note: CBN data-domestication directive and a bill; no licensing, switch or PAPSS fact.
Only data-transfer rules, no payment corridor.
A bill would class payment infrastructure as critical infrastructure; no designation or body stated.
No named data centre in service stated.

facts.fact: Business Post says the Central Bank of Nigeria in June directed all commercial banks and fintechs to store and process payment data in the country by 2027.
The directive was issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria to the banks and fintechs it licenses, per Business Post.
A bill introduced in the House of Representatives in the week before 2 November 2026 would require payment transaction data generated in Nigeria to be stored and processed in the country.
facts.system: National Payment Data Protection and Sovereignty Commission Bill

NGA.note: A payment-data bill, not a general data protection law.
Rules cover payment data of banks and fintechs, not government data.
Nothing on government payments to people.
No named nationally owned data centre.
Payment firms named in general; no service or switch stated.
Nothing on startup law or funds.
